shortDescription: TORONTO, ON / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / Aston Bay Holdings Ltd. TSXV:BAYOTC:ATBHF ("Aston Bay" or the "Company") announces that it has entered into an investor relations agreement (the "Agreement") with 2833943 Ontario Inc. and Sofia Harquail (the "Consultant"), effective May 1, 2026. children: ("Aston Bay" or the "Company") announces that it has entered into an investor relations agreement (the "

"), effective May 1, 2026. Pursuant to the Agreement, the Consultant will provide strategic investor relations and corporate communications services to the Company, including message development, corporate presentations, financial reporting support, investor and analyst outreach, and market intelligence.

In consideration for the services provided, the Company will pay the Consultant a monthly cash fee of $7,300 from working capital. The Agreement is for an initial term of twelve (12) months and continues on a month-to-month basis until terminated in accordance with its terms. No common shares, stock options, or other securities of the Company are issuable to the Consultant as compensation under the Agreement.

Prior to entering into the Agreement, the Consultant served as an employee of the Company from January 2018 until April 2026. As of the date hereof, the Consultant holds directly 1,401,030 common shares and 750,000 stock options of the Company.
This Agreement remains subject to acceptance by the TSX Venture Exchange.

Aston Bay is a publicly traded mineral exploration company exploring for high-grade critical and precious metal deposits in North America. The Company is exploring the Storm Copper Property and Epworth Cu-Ag-Zn-Co Property in Nunavut.
